items.title: Pando Sets Oct. 13 Hong Kong Listing for Spot Solana ETF
items.summary: The fund will charge a 0.60% annual management fee, adding another option alongside ChinaAMC’s Solana ETF, which held $8.58 million at the end of August.

items.title: Bitmine Adds $32M in Ethereum as Tom Lee Says Firm Is Nearly 'Done Stacking'
